name: Ruoshi Liu
title: Assistant Professor in the Computer Science Department at University of Maryland, Co
research: Our research aims to develop intelligent systems that can perceive and interact with the physical world . Our lab focuses on solving manipulation problems with the help of machine learning, geometric processing, and foundation models. We often experiment with different methods to leverage data from internet, simulation, and real world to create robust and generalizable representations and policies.
